[LEXP.7.18] **A method is a member.** A `.NAME` call on a receiver whose
type is statically known is a member read: [LGRA.9.6.2] resolves it by the
receiver's type and refuses, with `DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_MEMBER`, a name the type
does not carry. `DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_METHOD` stays allocated and is not raised
in this edition.
